categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in leasing and entertainment sectors, including rental income from commercial properties and revenue from leisure activities such as cinemas and amusement facilities. Leasing accounts for approximately 68% of total revenue, while entertainment (movies and amusement) contributes about 32%. The company also engages in diversified investments domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: As a service-oriented company, it does not engage in manufacturing or production. Its core operations rely on property management and leasing, digital cinema technology for movie screening, and management of amusement facilities. IT infrastructure includes IBM AS/400 and Windows systems for core business and support, with ongoing digital transformation and cybersecurity enhancements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include commercial tenants such as bookstores, restaurants, convenience stores, business hotels, and entertainment patrons in Taipei's prime commercial districts like Zhonghua Road and Ximending. Major tenants include Eslite Bookstore, various restaurants, hotels, and convenience store chains. The entertainment segment serves local consumers seeking cinema and amusement services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and revenue are entirely domestic, concentrated in Taipei City, Taiwan. Properties are located in central business and entertainment districts such as Zhonghua Road and Emei Street in Ximending. Overseas investments exist but are limited and accounted for under equity method.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the real estate and entertainment service supply chain, acting as a landlord and service provider. It leases properties to retail and hospitality tenants and manages entertainment venues directly or through partnerships. It does not engage in upstream production or manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company has no significant R&D activities or technology development. Strategic priorities include renewing lease contracts, enhancing amusement facilities, and pursuing diversified domestic and overseas investments. It is also focused on digital transformation of IT systems to improve operational efficiency and cybersecurity.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through rental income from commercial properties and income from entertainment operations such as cinema ticket sales and amusement facilities. The company also earns dividend income from investments. There is no manufacturing or product sales revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the entertainment sector, competitors include other cinema operators in Taipei such as Ambassador, Showtime, and Absolute theaters. In leasing, competition comes from other commercial property owners in prime Taipei locations. The company positions itself as a stable landlord and entertainment service provider with prime location assets and diversified tenant mix.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has total assets exceeding NT$9 billion and equity around NT$7.9 billion as of the latest fiscal year. Annual revenue is approximately NT$2.27 billion with a slight decline due to COVID-19 impacts. Profitability improved significantly with net income rising over 150% year-over-year. The company maintains strong liquidity and low debt ratios, with steady growth in retained earnings and equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers prime commercial real estate in central Taipei with convenient access and high foot traffic, attracting reputable tenants. Its entertainment venues provide quality digital cinema experiences and unique amusement facilities like baseball and shooting practice areas. Emphasis on stable rental income, diversified investments, and operational efficiency through digital transformation differentiates it in the market.
